title: runners.toml image-pattern and max_parallel validation is hand-mirrored Go/TS with no parity fixture
description:
INFORMATIONAL from the Phase 3 final review (tick csr).

internal/herd/config/load.go:100 and cloud/factory/src/repo-config.ts:151 carry an identical regex, with a comment saying it is mirrored from the other side, and no golden fixture tying them together. Every other Go/TS shape in this epic has one — the tracker-layout fixture, the worker-boot contract — so this is the single contract without a test that would catch drift directly.

Currently in sync, and backstopped by an independent boot-time check (the sandbox entrypoint refuses to boot if the declared image disagrees with what booted), so one-sided drift would fail loud rather than silent. That backstop is why this is informational and not a defect.

.tick/learnings.md's rule is explicit: any constant or format crossing the Go/TS boundary needs a cross-implementation golden test, because both suites stay green while each is internally consistent.
acceptance_criteria: A golden fixture asserted from both Go and TypeScript pins the image pattern and max_parallel validation, in the same idiom as tracker-layout.json.
